build_compose_pipeline: build a Compose pipeline from a sequence of transform dicts or callables for sequential data transformation
create_compose_with_cfg: create a Compose object that auto-builds transform instances from config dicts using mmcv build_from_cfg
run_compose_transforms: run the Compose call method to apply all registered transforms sequentially to a data dict
test_compose_none_propagation: test that Compose returns None early when any transform in the sequence returns None
review_compose_repr: review the Compose repr method to inspect the list of composed transforms in a readable format
